design_gate.real_baseline: STRUCTURAL raw reader (any extracted object = affected), recomputed in-cell
design_gate.can_fail: gen_margin<=0.05 => gate no better than structural on INDEPENDENT labels => the co-defined asterisk was load-bearing (GATE_NO_LIFT_INDEPENDENT)
design_gate.difficulty_on: real UD-EWT test web-text + an annotator BLIND to the gate lexicon
design_gate.leak_clean: gate = verb-lemma + parse-frame + argument-animacy, gold-independent; self_test permutes gold labels + re-derives -> pred vectors byte-identical; inverting gold_yes gives inverted_acc==1-orig exactly
design_gate.span_normalization: strip '(...)' parenthetical then v1 span_head_tokens (drop dets/stopwords)
design_gate.crlb_n/a: accuracy on labeled gold, no noise floor
design_gate.calibration_check: default_ok_for_this_regime (0.35 = v2 builder spot-check 94.4% dec acc)
